title: The AI rewrite always answers: a sample of about ten words for an empty or meaningless box, a rewrite at most ten words longer for meaningful text, the same length on a repeat press, and never more than fifty words
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-rewrite.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'an empty box gets one sample sentence of about ten words, asked about the question' passes.
'nonsense typed in is told apart by the model and gets a sample, not a rewrite of the nonsense' passes.
'text that means something is rewritten within ten more words and fifty in all' passes.
'a second press with no edit keeps the length of the text, in different words' passes.
'a rewrite is never longer than fifty words, even from a long original' and 'a sample is about ten words; "again" keeps the length of the text it was given' pass.

selectors.doorWrite: POST /api/sites/brief/rewrite {text, question, again} -> {text, words, sourceWords, mode}

fence: The length rule of each mode is counted by boundsFor/judgeRewrite on the model's answer, with one repair round and then a refusal. Pure: a scripted model double, no network, no Postgres.

tests: an empty box gets one sample sentence of about ten words
nonsense typed in is told apart by the model
text that means something is rewritten within ten more words and fifty in all
a second press with no edit keeps the length of the text
a rewrite is never longer than fifty words
a sample is about ten words
